title: Agent-platform foundation execution event
description: One append-only record of a program step. Every step emits exactly two events: a step_started before work begins and a step_finished carrying a terminal status. An unmatched step_started means the work was interrupted and must never be read as success. This schema extends the P0-A execution-ledger shape rather than replacing it: the P0-A core fields (actor, branch, head_before, objective, command_or_action, expected, actual, exit_code, files_touched, evidence_refs, caused_by, blocker) are all retained.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier. START and FINISH share the same stem.

status.description: null on step_started; required on step_finished. A SKIP is not a PASS and a BLOCKED result is not evidence of safety.

expected.description: The observable postcondition, stated before the command runs.

exit_code.description: The TRUE process exit code. null when the process was terminated by a signal — never invented, never read through a pipe.

signal.description: Populated when the process was terminated by a signal.

independent_checker.description: The separate tool or process that read the postcondition. A claim verified only by the component under test is not independent.

environment_variable_names.description: Variable NAMES only. Values are never recorded, in any event, for any reason.
